assembly: The two Flash Markdown outputs were concatenated in page order without normalization or semantic rewriting.
retained_extraction_comparison: The fresh Flash extraction differs from assets/attachments/extracted/analysis_2003-2007.md; the old extraction had unknown provenance and was not used as source evidence.
real_analysis_reconciliation: The compilation has 45 unique real-analysis source positions: 15 in 2003, 12 in 2004, 3 in 2005, 3 in 2006, and 12 in 2007. The 2006 real-analysis exam is duplicated verbatim in the packet. Four previously missing 2003 Part II owners were added and Part II Problem 3 reuses P-WESRA08-II4. Four retained cards have no Flash source-check event because the deterministic extraction does not settle a specific glyph or omitted expression: P-WESRA03-I9, P-WESRA04-P2, P-WESRA05-2, and P-WESRA07-II2.
complex_analysis_reconciliation: The compilation has 50 complex-analysis source positions: 13 in 2004, 13 in 2005, 11 in 2006, and 13 in 2007. Four new Wesleyan complex-analysis collections represent all positions. Exact repeated prompts reuse earlier Wesleyan owners within the packet; 2004 Problem 6 reuses P-JHUU45CA1 and 2006 Problem 4 reuses P-EMCA9 rather than duplicating existing canonical statements.
